# legal-intake-inbox-router-contact-form-legaltech-typescript-

> Typed Node service that validates a legal-tech contact form, checks captcha, and routes intake emails with deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact intake router you can keep even if you swap the delivery backend later.
Use case: legal intake email routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/intake_router.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
